# Overview

This report summarises the outputs from the automated DATA201 data wrangling pipeline.

The pipeline processes the Airbnb and tenancy datasets through Deliverables 3, 4 and 5. The Makefile controls the order of each stage and automatically rebuilds outputs when required.

---

# Deliverable 3 — Data Preparation and Initial Analysis

## Combined Airbnb Data

```{r d3-data}
combined_listings <- read_csv(
  "output_data/Deliverable3_output/combined_listings.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

glimpse(combined_listings)
```

## Example Data

Only the most useful columns are shown below to keep the table readable.

```{r d3-preview}
combined_listings |>
  select(
    id,
    neighbourhood,
    room_type,
    price,
    number_of_reviews,
    month,
    year
  ) |>
  head(6) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Example Airbnb Listings",
    digits = 2
  )
```

## Date Difference

```{r d3-date-plot, echo=FALSE, out.width="85%"}
knitr::include_graphics(
  "output_data/Deliverable3_output/date_difference.png"
)
```

## Price Distribution

```{r d3-price-plot, echo=FALSE, out.width="85%"}
knitr::include_graphics(
  "output_data/Deliverable3_output/price_distribution.png"
)
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r d3-summary}
summary_statistics <- read_csv(
  "output_data/Deliverable3_output/summary_statistics.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

summary_statistics |>
  select(
    variable,
    type,
    total_rows,
    missing,
    missing_percent,
    unique_values
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Dataset Summary Statistics",

```

# Deliverable 4 — Data Cleaning

## Cleaned Airbnb Dataset

```{r d4-airbnb}
airbnb_cleaned <- read_csv(
  "output_data/Deliverable4_output/Airbnb_listings_cleaned.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

glimpse(airbnb_cleaned)
```

## Example Cleaned Airbnb Data

```{r d4-airbnb-preview}
airbnb_cleaned |>
  select(
    id,
    neighbourhood,
    room_type,
    price,
    availability_365,
    month,
    year
  ) |>
  head(6) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Cleaned Airbnb Data",
    digits = 2
  )
```

## Cleaned Airbnb Price Distribution

The extreme top 1% of prices are excluded from this graph only so the normal price distribution is easier to read. The original data is not changed.

```{r d4-airbnb-plot}
price_limit <- quantile(
  airbnb_cleaned$price,
  0.99,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

airbnb_cleaned |>
  filter(
    !is.na(price),
    price <= price_limit
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = price)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 40
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Cleaned Airbnb Prices",
    subtitle = "Extreme top 1% excluded from visualisation",
    x = "Price per Night ($NZD)",
    y = "Number of Listings"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Pipeline Summary

The automated pipeline performs the following stages:

1. Combines the monthly Airbnb datasets.
2. Produces the Deliverable 3 analyses.
3. Cleans the Airbnb and tenancy datasets.
4. Assigns geographic SA2 codes to Airbnb listings.
5. Joins Airbnb and tenancy information.
6. Performs the Deliverable 5 analyses.
7. Generates this report automatically.

The full pipeline can be executed using:

```text
make all
```
